- **Story:** As Steve, I want live loop status published to my phone with clean stopping and one-word escalation paths, so that I can see progress and answer only decisions that genuinely need me.
- **One observable behaviour:** While looping, the status and MOB.md publish and the heartbeat keep updating, a STOP file ends the loop cleanly, and a one-way door writes one one-word ask for the product owner.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the loop tests with the fake CLIs and a fixture board, When the behaviour above is exercised, Then the summary publish and heartbeat update during every phase (also while a child runs); a stalled heartbeat is visible in the published MOB.md
  2. Given the loop tests with the fake CLIs and a fixture board, When the behaviour above is exercised, Then the loop stops ONLY for a `.mob/STOP` file (after the current atomic step, no new card started), a one-way door that needs the product owner (written to the Needs-product-owner file; the loop waits for the one-word reply), or all driver allotments out (card 072: it pauses, it does not end)
  3. Given the loop tests with the fake CLIs and a fixture board, When the behaviour above is exercised, Then an escalation writes `.mob/loop/escalate.md` (options, one line each, a recommendation, one word) shown in MOB.md as needs the product owner; the loop polls `escalate.reply` for the answer
